name: Mika Isadora
source:
As the student prime minister at Hyde Collegiate Institute, Mika Isadora bears many responsibilities that would make the average student’s head spin but, in exchange, her position also grants her various privileges not afforded to the average student.

Mika is a very unique student at Hyde as she did not come from a wealthy background. She lived with her single father in rural Scotland for most of her life. However, in spite of her poor upbringing, she excelled in her studies and managed to attain a scholarship at Hyde. She even managed to work her way to the top. A real prodigy. 

However, there always remains an air of unhappiness around her and she’s not viewed as particularly likable. However, for some odd reason, she grew a bit more comfortable around the presence of a certain delinquent who often frequents her office due to his bad behaviour. That delinquent is none other than Shuyaku Hyland.
